name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 7 visits over 54 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 16 hours starting 2026-06-08, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 3.73 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
